legendModal.title: Heartbeat Module Indicator & Status Guide
legendModal.subtitle: Color meanings, time thresholds, root causes, and troubleshooting procedures
legendModal.tips: 💡 Tip: You can enable the automated audio alarm (*Sound Alarm*) when status turns red.

live.label: 🟢 ACTIVE / LIVE
live.meaning: Hardware module heartbeat is healthy and normal.
live.cause: Serial USB communications and MQTT broker connections are operating seamlessly.
live.action: No action needed. System is operating at peak performance.

delay.label: 🟡 WARNING / DELAY
delay.meaning: Latency or delay detected in heartbeat packet ingestion.
delay.cause: High LAN network traffic, heavy MQTT broker load, or minor microcontroller latency.
delay.action: Monitor continuously. If status reverts to green automatically, system is safe. If delay persists >12s, status escalates to red (Dead).

dead.label: 🔴 DEAD / TIMEOUT
dead.meaning: Module completely offline / zero incoming heartbeat packets.
dead.cause: Loose or disconnected USB serial cable, module power supply outage, or ttyUSB driver crash.
dead.action:
1. Click "Ping Status" / "Reset" button.
2. If status stays red, physically inspect USB cables and power plugs on the Pod unit.

frozen.label: 🟣 FROZEN / STALLED
frozen.meaning: MQTT packets incoming, but HB counter value remains static (stuck).
frozen.cause: Microcontroller firmware deadlock or frozen in the serial communication loop.
frozen.action: Dispatch a "RESET" command from the dashboard or power-cycle the microcontroller board.

flash.label: ⚡ PACKET FLASH
flash.meaning: Glow animation indicating incoming realtime telemetry packet just received.
flash.cause: MQTT telemetry payload just ingested by broker and processed by the dashboard.
flash.action: Visual confirmation that active live data streaming is underway.
